learning_outcomes.text: Introduce the fields of study in bachelor study programs "Engineering" and "Theoretical Fundamentals in Mechanical Engineering".
Acquire knowledge of fundamentals in Environmental, Power and Process Engineering.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the topics, information about specializations
Educational excursion scoped on Power Engineering (EC Kladno, ZEVO)
Educational excursion scoped on Environmental Engineering (NTK)
Educational excursion scoped on Process Engineering (Staropramen, Mitas)
A more detailed presentation of problematics in Power Engineering related to the excursion
A more detailed presentation of problematics in Environmental Engineering related to the excursion
A more detailed presentation of problematics in Process Engineering related to the excursion
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
